title: Welcome Start with an already-full phone record closes the cover without finishOnboarding, so onboarded stays false and saves never count toward the backup offer
evidence: Done by PR 1602 (d5db9e3db): Cover.transition sends welcome x started(needs: false) to (.none, .finish), so Start on a full record finishes (App/FirstRun.swift); pinned by the "started full" cell of FirstRunTests.testEveryCoverAndEvent_US54. Was: ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift:159 sets firstRun to nil when needsQuestions is false, skipping finishOnboarding (:250-258, which sets onboarded). The backup offer counts own saves only when onboarded (:102), so it never fires. The connected path (:163) calls finishOnboarding. Reachable only with a full phone record before the welcome screen. May be fixed inside the S9/S16 build
